subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu identity source should OpenClaw use for multi-bot @mention recognition when WebSocket mention open_id values are scoped to another app?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the submitted union_id source is contradicted by the canonical issue and the identity choice directly controls Feishu group message delivery.

options.title: Rebuild Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable identity field exists in real Feishu bot/group payloads and carrying it through all mention admission paths.

options.title: Replace With Alias Mapping
options.body: Move the canonical fix to a narrower replacement that maps known cross-app identifiers without relying on unavailable bot union_id data.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause or close this PR if maintainers confirm the union_id source cannot work for bots.

recommendation.title: Rebuild Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable identity field exists in real Feishu bot/group payloads and carrying it through all mention admission paths.
